messages.subject: Re: How to create numeric input box for all variables in a dataset?
parts:
I am new to R and have very basic query. I want to create numeric input boxes with names as names of all columns. I was trying to create the below code with name of input box as "contact". But this code doesn't work. Any suggestions on how to approach this. Also, after creating the numeric box, i want to store the values entered by user in ui to a data table. I couldn't find any feature that does this.

library(shiny)

data_set = data.frame(Name = c ("ABC","ABC","ABC","DEF","DEF", "XYZ", "XYZ", "PQR"),
                       Country = c("US, Japan","US, Japan","US, Japan","Canada, US","Canada, US", "UK, US", "UK, US", "Germany"),
                       Region = c("North America, Asia","North America, Asia","North America, Asia","North America","North America", "Europe, North America", "Europe, North America", "Europe"),
                       Contact = c(1234,1234,1234,7578,7578,9898,9898,7660),
                       ContactPerson = c("Geoff","Mary","Mike","Don","Sean","Jessica","Justin","John"))

if (interactive()) {
  
  # demoing optgroup support in the `choices` arg
  shinyApp(
    ui = fluidPage(
      numericInput("data_set[,4]", "var",30,),
 verbatimTextOutput("value")
      ),
    
    server = function(input, output) {
      output$value <- renderText({
        paste("You chose", input$criteria)
      
      })
    }
  )

}
